messages:
mari-eng: Heads up — planning a rolling drain + reboot window in apac-edge (apac-west1) tonight 02:00–05:00 UTC. Purpose: NIC microcode + BMC fixes. We'll cordon cohorts to avoid broad disruption; expect brief latency spikes for Dedicated pools. Details below.

alex-sre: Cohort size/cadence?

mari-eng: 5 nodes per cohort, ~15m drain, 10m cooldown, backfill between cohorts. 4 cohorts total. We'll avoid bursting into eu/us unless we hit capacity limits.

jamie-oncall: I'm oncall for the window and can shadow. Rollback criteria?

mari-eng: Rollback/abort triggers: - P95 latency > 300ms for >5m => pause and roll back; - request error rate >2% sustained for 3m => abort and escalate; - any capacity deficit causing >5% queueing on host level => abort. I'll post live metrics.

tessa-platform: Need prefix/KV cache warm after each cohort to avoid cold KVs causing tail latency. Plan to run: `tools/cache_warm --region apac-west1 --prefix "model_*" --parallel 8` right after cohort backfill.

liu-infra: Can we pre-seed standby nodes before cordon to reduce regen? Storage IO was the limiter last time.

mari-eng: We tested pre-seed; limited by NVMe IO. Updated plan: seed between cohorts on the drained nodes using incremental rsync and then run cache_warm. See runbook: https://redwood.internal/runs/apac-edge-maint-2026 (passworded).

deploy-bot: Scheduled maintenance ticket RED-OPS-410 created (owner: mari-eng). ETA 2026-03-20T02:00Z.

rachel-support: We'll send customer notice to high-volume tenants. Can you DM me the list of top-5 Dedicated tenants to include?

mari-eng: Will DM @rachel-support the tenant list in 10m. Also tagging tenants with pinned capacity so they get SLA fallback info.

alex-sre: Ops snippets to use: ```kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data <node> --grace-period=60``` then ```redwoodctl node reboot --id <node-id> --reason "apac nic microcode"``` followed by health-checks.

jamie-oncall: I'll run the post-cohort smoke: `tests/latency_smoke.sh --region apac-west1 --models small,medium` and post results.

tessa-platform: Cost note: if we need cross-region backfill it's estimated ~ $1.2k extra for a 3h backfill (egress & burst GPUs). Keep finance in the loop if we hit that.

mari-eng: Fallback policy if cohort fails: auto-route affected requests to apac-east1 read-only pool + model-variant downgrade (e.g., redwood/llama-medium-8q -> -6q). We'll only enable downgrade for non-critical tenants and have canary traffic first.

liu-infra: Preparing dashboards: p95/p99 latency, error-rate, node queue depth, NVMe IO. I'll add a temporary panel and set pager thresholds.

rachel-support: I'll draft the tenant comms with timeframe and mitigation notes; will ask legal for wording on SLA impact.

mari-eng: Final checklist before 01:30 UTC: - preflight telemetry snapshot saved, - runbook pinned, - canary cohort ready, - support + oncall pagers staffed. Ping here when done.

alex-sre: Preflight done from my side, canary cohort ready.

jamie-oncall: I'll be in the war room #eng-infra-maint and have phone on.

mari-eng: Thanks everyone — will post live updates in this thread during the window. :thumbsup:
